name: Crank It!
summary: Inspired by the hand-held, electronic game Bop It!, our version of Crank It! recreates this party-game classic on the Playdate. Fun for all ages, get ready to Crank it, Shake it and Press it, as you race against the clock to keep up with the commands. With lightning-fast reflexes and razor-sharp focus, win the game by scoring 100 points. When you make a mistake, everyone will get a laugh out of the good-humored “taunts”.
